title: Modern Leading-Edge Manufacturing
description: After the unit processes and EUV exist: High-NA, stochastics as a limiter, advanced devices, packaging, and the scaling constraints a reporter actually meets.

sourceReferences.title: ASML EUV lithography systems
sourceReferences.notes: NXE 0.33 vs EXE 0.55. High-NA after EUV is already thinkable.

sourceReferences.title: ASML lithography principles
sourceReferences.notes: NA is not a score. Wavelength travels with it.

sourceReferences.title: ASML High-NA EXE platform
sourceReferences.notes: 0.55 as a new scanner family: anamorphic optics, half field, faster stages.

sourceReferences.title: imec: entering the nanosheet transistor era
sourceReferences.notes: Nanosheet GAA, forksheet, CFET as a device sequence after fins.

sourceReferences.title: imec: backside power delivery
sourceReferences.notes: Decouple power from front-side signal routing. Alignment and thinning are the bill.

concepts.name: High-NA EUV
concepts.summary: 0.55 NA as a new scanner family, not a bigger number on the same tool.

concepts.name: Anamorphic High-NA optics
concepts.summary: Different demagnification in X and Y so the mask stays printable.
objectives: Explain anamorphic High-NA optics as different demagnification in X and Y so the mask stays printable

concepts.name: High-NA mask 3D effects
concepts.summary: The absorber has thickness. At these angles that matters.

Predict a CD or placement error that comes from the mask stack, not the wafer

concepts.name: High-NA process implications
concepts.summary: Smaller depth of focus, new resists, new inspection.
objectives: Predict how a thinner High-NA focus slice changes resist thickness and inspection
Contrast a High-NA process window with the 0.33-NA window already taught

concepts.name: Mask 3D effects
concepts.summary: A '2D' pattern sitting on a multilayer is not 2D to the light.

concepts.name: Anamorphic imaging
concepts.summary: Why the reticle field is no longer a simple 4× shrink in both axes.

concepts.name: Stochastics as a scaling wall
concepts.summary: More NA does not buy you photons.

concepts.name: Leading-edge defectivity

concepts.name: Yield models

concepts.name: FinFETs

concepts.name: Multi-beam inspection and write
